title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
description:
arXiv:2610.36068v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures.
